system.description: Once per turn, when a magiseed leaves your garden, if it has one or more "at the end of your turn" effects, spend 20 MP to reproduce one of them — including an effect that does not match your current filled sections. And with Verdant Sway, your Rituals may influence and control soldier-Rank plant-Species creatures; never create them. Read the first clause against Wrathful Carnation: voluntary removal is a magiseed leaving your garden, and so is Graft. This is how a Floralist fires a tier-3 effect from a clock sitting at 1.
